prompts:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: high-fidelity desktop research software interface concept screenshot, for a Chinese undergraduate thesis about Transformer-based beyond-line-of-sight vehicle-road cooperative active collision avoidance. Create one complete wide landscape 16:9 screen, ideally 2048x1152 or higher. Flat full-screen UI screenshot without device mockup, perspective tilt, desk, or browser address bar. Shared style across screens: professional restrained engineering application, white and pale gray surfaces, charcoal typography, hairline gray dividers, clean CJK sans-serif typography, modest spacing, flat rectangular panels, no ornamental decoration, no gradient/glow, no neon/cyberpunk, no oversized dashboard KPI cards, no marketing style. Muted blue denotes ego vehicle and selected controls, muted red denotes hazard, neutral gray denotes unavailable actions. Accurate legible short Simplified Chinese labels, not dense paragraphs. Top header verbatim: "车路协同主动避撞实验平台". Top tabs verbatim: "仿真总览", "轨迹与决策", "实验评估". Persistent small but clearly visible top-right label verbatim: "界面概念稿 · 非运行截图". All charts, probabilities, and trajectories are conceptual illustrations, not real experiment evidence. Do not claim validated model performance, collision reduction percentages, or production deployment. Avoid company logos and third-party branding.
Primary request: Screen 1, the simulation overview, with 仿真总览 tab selected. A usable experiment console, not an abstract illustration. Layout: slim left configuration sidebar about 16%, central simulation viewport about 55%, right synchronized perception column about 29%, a slim bottom playback/event strip spanning central and right region. Sidebar short readable labels: "场景配置", "建筑遮挡交叉口", "预测模型", "RC-STGT", "通信扰动", "延迟", "丢包", and restrained buttons "开始仿真", "暂停", "重置". Main central panel title "仿真观察视角"; fill it with an attractive realistic CARLA-like rendered urban four-way intersection in ordinary daylight, clearly visible road lane markings, sidewalks, opaque buildings. Ego blue car approaches intersection from south heading north; one red hazard vehicle approaches from west heading east, visible from elevated spectator viewpoint. Southwest corner building blocks the ego front camera line of sight to the red west vehicle. A roadside camera on northeast corner can see the west approach. Scene must be physically credible and consistent. Draw sparse thin predicted path overlays showing approaching intersection conflict, not laser beams. Mark ego "本车" and hazard "T-07" with small neat overlay tags. Right column top camera panel title "车载视角": coherent forward camera approaching same intersection, west hazard occluded by the southwest building; below second panel title "路侧视角": elevated roadside camera of same intersection, hazard T-07 visibly enclosed in a thin red detection box, a few other neutral detection boxes. Under camera panels a short decision area labels "危险目标 T-07", "风险：高", "建议动作：AEB制动" and "横向来车进入冲突区域". Bottom a straightforward horizontal timeline with play button and marked event steps "发现目标", "风险升高", "开始制动". A small footer note "场景与状态仅作界面示意". Keep panels sufficiently large, avoid tiny unreadable dense data. This must look like a buildable technical thesis demo app.

Primary request: Screen 2, trajectory and decision analysis, with 轨迹与决策 tab selected. Same design as the overview, coherent research app. Left two thirds a large orthographic bird's-eye map panel titled "融合观测与未来轨迹". Draw a geometrically clean four-way intersection, sidewalks and pale gray buildings, north up. A blue ego rectangle at south faces north; red target T-07 at west faces east; small neutral other vehicles. Thin dashed blue candidate ego path proceeds north; a fan of six plausible red future trajectory hypotheses from T-07, prominent main eastbound path, alternatives only following valid road lanes with no passing through buildings. A discrete outlined conflict area at intersection, no heatmap rainbow. Past tracks solid thin lines, future tracks dashed, clean compact legend labels "历史轨迹", "预测轨迹", "本车候选". The hazard is an unobserved west vehicle for the car front camera but roadside-sourced; small annotation "路侧补充目标 T-07". Right one third: a structured decision panel titled "候选动作复核", four rows "保持行驶" status "存在冲突"; "AEB制动" status "入选示意" with muted blue selection; "向右避让" status "通道占用"; "向左避让" status "道路约束". No numerical risk probabilities invented. Below this, small title "决策依据" and concise lines "横向车辆进入冲突区", "制动候选满足道路约束", "侧向通道不可用". At bottom across full width, two compact aligned scientific line charts titles "风险随时间变化（示意）" and "速度与制动响应（示意）", sparse axes with time labels and thin blue/red/gray curves, no empirical improvement numbers. Explicit chart annotation "示意曲线 · 非实验结果". Main screen header small settings "预测窗口 4 s", "规划窗口 3 s" mark these configuration values, not measured results. Do not portray a risk score as a validated calibrated probability. Functional controls "目标选择", "候选动作", "导出当前帧" unobtrusive and professional.

Primary request: Screen 3, experiment evaluation and paired replay, with 实验评估 tab selected. Same simple professional white engineering UI. The page should demonstrate how a final thesis platform helps review experiments. Top narrow control bar has filters "场景", "模型", "策略", buttons "运行对比" and "导出报告". Under it, paired replay section: two side-by-side landscape simulation panels labeled "基线策略" and "车路协同避撞". Show matched elevated viewpoints of exactly the same ordinary urban intersection, buildings, road geometry, blue ego sedan approaching from south and red cross-traffic vehicle from west. At a representative risk moment, left shows the two thin predicted paths converging at conflict area with a small red "冲突预警" annotation; right shows blue ego stopping before conflict line while red vehicle crosses, with small blue "制动介入" annotation. No crashed cars, no exaggerated accident, no fake measured success claims. Caption across both panels "同场景配对回放 · 画面示意". Middle row three compact analytical panels with classic clean chart styling: "轨迹预测误差", "不同通信延迟下的表现", "控制平顺性". Use sample silhouettes / muted illustrative thin bars and curves; each chart prominently says "示意数据"; axes use metric names but avoid specific numeric performance values and no percentages of improvement. Bottom an actual readable experiment-record table columns "场景", "模型", "策略", "运行状态", "结果"; rows include "遮挡交叉口 / CV / AEB / 待运行 / —", "遮挡交叉口 / RC-STGT / AEB + AES / 待运行 / —", "通信中断 / RC-STGT / 本地回退 / 待运行 / —". Clear short footer "实验完成后显示真实统计与日志". Keep text sparse and readable and prioritize useful replay/comparison workflow, not flashy analytics art.

edit_prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit of this Chinese desktop UI concept. Preserve overall layout, all panel positions, typography, restrained white/blue design, most Chinese text, and persistent "界面概念稿 · 非运行截图". Make exactly these scientific-label corrections: (1) In bottom-left risk chart, relabel the red legend "保持行驶（示意）", blue legend "AEB制动（示意）", and vertical axis "风险评分（无量纲）", so both curves describe the SAME ego-vehicle candidate risk under different actions, not one risk for each actor. Preserve a red curve rising and a blue low curve as conceptual placeholders, not calibrated probabilities. (2) In bottom-right panel change title to "车辆速度（示意）". Only show solid blue ego velocity and solid muted-red other-vehicle velocity, both in m/s on shared speed axis. REMOVE the dashed brake-command curve and its legend entirely. Blue velocity decreases smoothly to zero and never below zero, red target velocity stays roughly constant; legend "本车速度" and "目标车速度". Keep "示意曲线 · 非实验结果" under both charts. (3) In the large map REPLACE the radial red ray fan with three plausible representative ROAD-FOLLOWING paths, initially following the west approach lane eastwards together then branching only inside the intersection: straight east, smooth left turn into a valid northbound lane, smooth right turn into a valid southbound lane. No straight diagonal rays, no wrong-way lanes, no sidewalk crossing, no path through buildings. Add small label "显示代表性预测模式". Keep blue ego path and red conflict area. This remains a UI concept, not an actual simulation screenshot. Do not add new decorative elements.

Use case: precise-object-edit of this Chinese desktop experiment evaluation UI concept. Keep exact professional light UI style, page structure, top tabs, all chart and replay panel positions, original scene geometry, experiment table with 待运行, and persistent label "界面概念稿 · 非运行截图". Correct the paired replay: show same simulation timestamp "t = 2.8 s" in BOTH panels, with the same RED west-to-east target vehicle at EXACTLY the same world location near the conflict point, and all OTHER background traffic and scenery at the same world locations. Only BLUE ego car state/path differs: in left baseline panel ego blue car is closer to the intersection and thin forward candidate path converges with the target's path, annotate "冲突预警"; in right cooperative avoidance panel ego is further SOUTH, stopped safely behind the approach stop line, annotate "制动介入", with a short blue stopping path. Both blue cars must be visible and there is no physical crash. This is a fixed-other-traffic illustrative paired experiment. Also fix left bottom chart legend for prediction error to "CV" (muted red) and "RC-STGT" (blue), because error is compared by forecasting model. Do not label prediction error as a control strategy difference. Leave all charts prominently "示意数据"; no empirical success claim. All Chinese should remain crisp and accurate. No added glowing paths or decorations.

last_edit_prompt: Edit only the paired-replay images in this UI screenshot. Preserve ALL other pixels, chart labels, app layout, colors, table and text as closely as possible. The left replay viewport is missing the red target car. Restore ONE red sedan in the LEFT replay viewport by copying the red sedan already present in the RIGHT replay viewport to exactly the SAME relative road location in the LEFT viewport (on horizontal cross-street near center intersection, just east of the blue dashed northbound path). In the supplied 1672-wide preview, the desired car center is approximately x=477,y=312 in the left image, corresponding to the right car center x=1286,y=312; use relative viewport positions if full resolution differs. Both panels must visibly show one red sedan at matching world coordinates for the same t=2.8s, with unchanged identical background traffic. Keep blue ego sedan closer to intersection in left panel and stopped further south in right panel. Do not remove, recolor or hide any vehicle. Do not modify graphs or Chinese labels. Keep "界面概念稿 · 非运行截图" and all "示意数据" marks.
